Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 21: the slip of [[A Jedi's Plans (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on a site. Nightfall is canceled. While you have 8 or fewer cards in hand, non-unique characters (except clones), vehicles, starships, weapons, and devices are immune to Monnok. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to ▼ Jedi Archives or a battleground planet location (except a sector) not on table. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[A Jedi's Plans (V)]]. The label under the slip reads “•Wise Advice (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
